platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

deviceTarget.description: Device target form. Maps to the CLI --target flag.

target.description: Alias for deviceTarget on commands without a UI target field. Interaction commands reserve target for the UI element.

serial.description: Android device or Vega VVD serial selector.

iosSimulatorDeviceSet.description: iOS simulator device-set path used for device resolution.

iosXctestrunFile.description: Externally built iOS XCTest runner .xctestrun artifact path.

iosXctestDerivedDataPath.description: Derived data path for external iOS XCTest runner execution.

iosXctestEnvDir.description: Writable directory for iOS XCTest runner env overlays.

androidDeviceAllowlist.description: Android serial allowlist used for device resolution.

app.description: App name, bundle id, package, or URL.

url.description: Optional URL passed with an app shell.

surface.description: macOS presentation surface to open: the app itself, the frontmost app, the desktop, or the menu bar.

launchArgs.description: Launch arguments forwarded verbatim to the platform launch command.

foreground.description: Include an initial interactive snapshot in a fresh open response. With no app argument, discover the sole running app on the sole booted iOS simulator; ambiguous environments fail closed.

force.description: Overwrite an existing --save-script target instead of refusing (alias: --overwrite).

deviceHub.description: Use Xcode Device Hub when surfacing Apple simulators.

testIme.description: Activate the headless Android test IME for deterministic Unicode text entry (default on for emulators; opt-in on real devices).

metroHost.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug host hint applied to the opened app.

metroPort.description: Session-scoped Metro/debug port hint applied to the opened app. On an emulator/simulator the host defaults to the loopback alias (Android 10.0.2.2, iOS 127.0.0.1) when --metro-host is omitted; physical devices still require an explicit --metro-host.

bundleUrl.description: Session-scoped bundle URL hint applied to the opened app.

launchUrl.description: Session-scoped launch URL hint applied to the opened app.

mcpOutputFormat.description: MCP text content format. Defaults to optimized agent-friendly text; use json for JSON text. Structured content is always returned separately.

includeCost.description: Include per-command agent-cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) in structuredContent. Defaults to off; the default response shape is unchanged.

responseLevel.description: Response verbosity: token-cheap digest / default (today) / full. Defaults to default; the default response shape is unchanged.
